title: Ship self-contained score processor container build resource
description: Add a packaged Dockerfile and resource locator. The Dockerfile must install Plexus scoring dependencies from an explicit immutable revision using BuildKit secret authentication and must not COPY source from a repository checkout. Verify wheel and sdist contents.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Self-contained Dockerfile resource ships in the wheel, requires an immutable SHA, uses the committed lockfile, and exposes credentials only as an ephemeral build secret.
